name: Infection Analyse Results - Part 3
content: The latest tests have shown promising results. We have found that a combination of honey and the blue plasma can effectively carry the cure, but the active agent has to be taken from the creatures themselves. A lunar parasite tooth holds enough of the pathogen's structure to train the body against it. The mixture is potent, yet it breaks down within minutes of being prepared, so one piece of the puzzle is still missing before we can move on to testing.
